description: A ready-to-use, MVVM-optimized WYSIWYG HTML Editor control for WPF applications by SpiceLogic Inc. Features a modern interface with vector graphic toolbar buttons that scale cleanly across all screen sizes. Generates clean HTML and XHTML output. Includes built-in spell checker (dialog and inline, with NHunspell and OpenOffice dictionaries), customizable toolbar and dialogs, table manipulation, image insertion from file, internet, or clipboard with automatic Base64 conversion, clean MS Word paste conversion, FTP image upload, YouTube video embedding, two-way data binding support, and a comprehensive content manipulation API with caret positioning, HTML change events, and custom paste handling. Targets .NET Framework 4.5+ and .NET 5 through .NET 10.
releaseNotes: Fixed built-in toolbar buttons becoming invisible when moved into a custom WPF toolbar. Moved buttons now retain their appearance, follow toolbar icon size changes, and keep their existing click behavior. ALM bug #1469.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
